description: This file contains unit tests for the EmailService implementation in the book project, testing email sending functionalities including simple messages and template-based messages using GreenMail extension.

classes.name: EmailServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmailServiceImpl, testing email sending functionalities using GreenMail in a Spring Boot context.
